Universal testing machine Zwick/Roell ProLine Z050 
Universal testing machine for standardized tests with focus on fracture parameters measurements of metal-ceramics composites produced in PZMK. The main tests include: three- and four- point bending, Single-Edge V-Notched Beam (SEVNB), Compact Tension and tensile tests. 
The maximum applied force can reach 50kN. 
The accuracy of crosshead is up to 0,1N and drive speed can be set on 0,01mm/s.
